## Purpose and scope

Explain the problem, resulting behavior, and related issues. Write in English.

## Implementation and compatibility

Describe the key changes, compatibility risks, migrations, and any breaking behavior.

## Verification

List exact commands actually executed and their results. Identify failures and skipped checks. Do not claim hardware/server coverage from offline tests.

## Security and dependencies

Explain identity, authorization, network, workflow, dependency/license, or installation-hook changes. Confirm that evidence is sanitized and no credentials or personal paths are included.

## Documentation and review

- [ ] Relevant tests and documentation reflect the change.
- [ ] The actual diff was reviewed for unintended changes and private information.
- [ ] AI-assisted work follows AGENTS.md; the contributor has verified its claims.
- [ ] Known failures and unverified assumptions are disclosed above.
